ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% mid-intensity grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation covering the basal and central regions; mid-intensity grey mottling and radial streaking concentrated on the left lobe; localized mid-intensity grey patches on the distal third of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/10th of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitudes range from 4 to 12 pixels; highest density of sharp peaks located on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smooth convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-intensity (white) pixel clusters visible as small dots at the distal tip of the right lobe and at various peaks along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the left lobe mid-section at approximately 45-degree angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal rake marks on the left lobe; highly irregular jagged trailing edge suggesting historical tissue loss or heavy wear.
